about: Held-out voice cases (fake data), written by a separate author before any rule changes. Failures H05 and H19 guided the fixes in commit 48f050a, so this is a regression set, not an independent measure.

format.now: 2026-09-28T06:00:00Z (11:30 in India); dates are read in Asia/Kolkata time
format.case: { id, region, careType, text, expected: { values, confirm?, questions?, notes?, noValue? }, why }
format.values: Form paths that must be filled with exactly this value. Scalars: fullName, ageYears, phone (10 digits), address, motherName, pregnancy.lmp, pregnancy.scanEdd (YYYY-MM-DD), obstetric.gravida|para|living|abortions|previousCaesareans, obstetric.complicationsReviewed, medical.bloodGroup, medical.allergies, medical.heightCm, medical.weightKg, medical.conditionsReviewed, newborn.birthAt (local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM), newborn.birthWeightGrams, newborn.sex. Lists: medical.conditions and obstetric.pastComplications (tick-box keys, exact set); medical.otherConditions and notes (one case-insensitive regex per "; "-separated item, exact set). fullName, address, motherName and allergies compare ignoring case and punctuation; numbers compare as numbers; phone compares digits.
format.strict: Any path filled that is not in values or confirm counts as WRONG (an extra tick, note, other condition or field).
format.confirm: { path: { value, ask } }: blood group and Rh heard by voice go to the confirmation card (plan 2.6, owner decision 9). Correct if the path is filled with value, or left empty with a question matching the regex ask. Filled with another value is WRONG.
format.questions: Regexes (case-insensitive) that must each match one question ("prompt | heard | option labels"). Extra questions are allowed.
format.notes: Regexes that must each match one message in notes (or corrections). Extra messages are allowed.
format.noValue: Paths that must stay empty because the safe result is a question or note (documentation; any unexpected value is wrong anyway).
format.scoring: correct = no wrong and everything expected present; safe miss = no wrong but something expected missing; wrong = any different or unexpected value.
